events.title: "Beyond Heritage" RAIC Public Lecture by Rayleen Hill, NSAA, MRAIC
events.description: Join us on Thursday, May 21 st at 7:00 pm for a public lecture presented by the South Shore Network of the Royal Architectural Institute of Canada. This is a free event, no registration required. “Beyond Heritage” Rayleen reflects and weaves through RHAD’s vast portfolio of work from the last 15 years, connecting both their modern and heritage projects. As part of this reflection, Rayleen discusses her contemplations about heritage buildings and what preserving them ultimately means. She dives…

events.title: Gina Burgess Quintet & Natural Elements
events.description: An amazing night of fiddling, Inuit throat singing, Brazilian percussion, and much more! Gina Burgess is an ECMA-winning, genre-bending violinist and composer. Her performances feature an all-star 5-piece band, combining her violin with contemporary Inuit throat singing, drum kit, double bass, and Brazilian percussion. Natural Elements is contemporary folk music from fiddler-violinist Hayley Ryerson, performed with Ellen Gibling on harp.

events.title: Bel Canto Academy Concert 2026
events.description: Under the guidance of esteemed vocal coaches Rachelle Jonck , co-founder of Bel Canto Boot Camp, and Derrick Goff , resident artists will refine their technique and interpretation of this Italian-originated style, rooted in the 18th and 19th centuries. This special performance showcases the culmination of their work- an evening of Bel Canto masterpieces that highlight the beauty and nuance of the human voice.

events.title: Jazz at LAMP: The Music of Charles Mingus
events.description: Whether you're a long-time jazz lover or new to the genre, the Jazz Concert Series at LAMP promises to be a musical experience that will leave you spellbound. The LAMP Libations bar will be open - have a drink, hear some great jazz, and then head out to one of the many incredible restaurants in Lunenburg, Mahone Bay or Chester. What a fabulous night out!
